title: Learning from All-Failed Groups via First-Visit Coverage in Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2607.22724v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Group-based policy optimization has been increasingly used to train large language model (LLM) agents from sparse outcome rewards by comparing trajectories or steps within a group. However, on difficult long-horizon agentic tasks, we found this comparison suffers from a sampling imbalance: repeated or low-effect actions dominate the high-probability region of the policy, leaving useful state-changing actions under-sampled. This imbalance produces many all-failed rollout groups, where the relative advantages within such a group provide no direction for updating the policy. Consequently, the sampling imbalance and the all-failed groups collapse into a self-perpetuating credit trap: failure-dominated sampling yields no learning signal, allowing repeated low-effect actions to persist. translated_title: 在长程智能体任务中通过首次访问覆盖从全失败组中学习
translated_abstract: 基于组的策略优化（Group-based policy optimization）已被越来越多地用于通过比较组内的轨迹或步骤，从稀疏的结果奖励中训练大语言模型（LLM）智能体。然而，我们发现，在困难的长程智能体任务上，这种比较方式存在采样不平衡问题：重复的或低效用的动作主导了策略的高概率区域，使得能够改变状态的有用动作被欠采样。这种不平衡导致产生大量全失败的rollout组，而这类组内部的相对优势无法为策略更新提供任何方向。由此，采样不平衡与全失败组共同坍缩为一个自我延续的信用陷阱：以失败为主的采样无法产生学习信号，从而使重复的低效用动作得以持续存在。为了打破这一陷阱，我们提出了覆盖条件化组策略优化（Coverage-conditioned Group Policy Optimization, CovGPO），它仅当所有采样……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出CovGPO方法，通过在整组rollout全部失败时引入首次访问观测覆盖，为欠采样的状态改变动作提供学习信号，从而打破长程智能体任务中采样不平衡导致的自我延续信用陷阱。
en_tdlr: CovGPO breaks the self-perpetuating credit trap in long-horizon agentic tasks by leveraging first-visit observation coverage to supply learning signals for under-sampled state-changing actions when entire rollout groups fail.
